regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, graphical abstract, and metadata
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate visible-light 1,4-hydrofluoromethylation claim. The graphical abstract is a generic reaction-class summary and is linked to Scheme 1b rather than treated as an experiment-specific run.

regions.region: page 1 lower-left introduction and Scheme 1 discussion
regions.finding: Separated cited/general radical difunctionalization/HAT context from the authors' current radical-polar-crossover class. External cited reactions were not promoted to experiments of this article.

regions.region: page 1 right Scheme 1a-b and lower optimization paragraph
regions.finding: Classified Scheme 1a as a general principle and Scheme 1b as the current generic class. The page-1 prose supplies Table 1 entry 1 (1a 0.2 mmol, 2a 1.5 equiv, 4CzIPN 2 mol%, Cs2CO3 2 equiv, THF, blue LED, room temperature, 12 h, 3a 60% isolated yield), merged into the page-2 Table 1 row rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 1 generic R/Rad/Lg drawings do not define unique structures or experiment-specific outcomes.
The publisher SI link does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1-17, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Recorded all 17 optimization/control rows independently with row source equivalents, base/solvent, photocatalyst loading or omission, air/N2, light/dark, 12-24 h, isolated yield/NR/<5% outcomes, and the separate shared H2O dose. Entry 13 retains both the MeCN/H2O 20:1 solvent and the shared 3.6 uL H2O fact.

regions.region: page 2 right Table 2 reaction header, 26 product rows, caption, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all 26 enyne-scope rows 3a-3z separately with shared 1/2a/4CzIPN/Cs2CO3/MeCN/H2O conditions, blue LEDs, room temperature, N2, 12-24 h, and isolated yields. Positional series and complex structures remain source-labeled when exact encoding was uncertain.

Mapped para/meta/ortho substituent and complex-substrate statements to the existing Table 2 rows. The text introduces the later CHF2/CH2F radical-source scope but does not supply additional page-2 experiment rows beyond those displayed on page 3.

unresolved: Table 1/2 omit workups, purifications, isolated masses, and exact row times within the shared 12-24 h range.
NR has no printed numerical detection limit.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 3 header, rows 1-13, caption, and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded thirteen distinct CHF2/CH2F source-scope rows 3aa-3am with source identity applied by the depicted product blocks, shared doses/conditions, and isolated yields. The prose-only low-conversion statement was not converted into unsupported numeric conversions.

Recorded a distinct 5.0 mmol gram-scale 1c/2a reaction to 3c (875.6 mg, 71%) and a separate Pd/PPh3/K2CO3 arylation of 3c with methyl 4-iodobenzoate to diene 5 (73%). Every displayed dose is structured; unprinted times remain missing.
Recorded the MeCN-d6/H2O probe (3b 81%, <10% D) and MeCN/D2O probe (d-3b 23%, 96% D) as two distinct experiments with solvent/reagent volumes and product-targeted isotope outcomes.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 3c and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Classified I-V and photocatalyst redox states as a proposed radical-polar-crossover mechanism, not preparations. The prose assigns water as the proton source but does not add an independent experimental row.

unresolved: Scheme 2/3 omit reaction times and several workup/purification/yield-basis details.
The isotope measurement method is not reported.
The qualitative low-conversion statement is not mapped to individual numeric rows.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left conclusion continuation and Associated Content
regions.finding: The conclusion restates the developed hydrofluoromethylation, scale-up, and derivatization without adding a new condition or outcome. The publisher advertises Supporting Information, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
